title: Restricting a vaguely convergent sequence to an open set gives Radon convergence of varifolds on that set
statement: Let Ω ⊆ ℝ^N, c ∈ [0,∞), and let μ_i (i ∈ ℕ), μ be Borel measures on ℝ^N × G(N,n) with μ_i → μ vaguely, i.e. ∫ f dμ_i → ∫ f dμ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) (VagueConverges). Let W_i (i ∈ ℕ) and W be n-varifolds on Ω (Varifold N n Ω) whose measures are W_i.measure = c·(μ_i ⌞ (Ω × G)) and W.measure = c·(μ ⌞ (Ω × G)). Then W_i → W as Radon measures on G_n(Ω), i.e. Varifold.RadonConverges W_· W (convergence of ∫ f d(W_i)_dom for every f ∈ C_c(Ω × G)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (Ws : ℕ → Varifold N n Ω) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c : ℝ≥0∞), VagueConverges μs μ → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ i, (Ws i).measure = c • (μs i).restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) → W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → Varifold.RadonConverges Ws W
